description: Test suite for chat envelope processing functions 'stripEnvelope' and 'stripMessageIdHints' in the shared/chat-envelope module.

methods.name: stripEnvelope
methods.description: Removes recognized channel and timestamp envelope prefixes from message strings and preserves non-envelope headers.

methods.name: stripMessageIdHints
methods.description: Removes standalone message id hint lines from message strings and preserves inline mentions.
